services.name: Schedule A Program With Us
services.desc: Hands on learning: We have animal mounts, furs, tracks, and replica-scat and more for your students to use. Visual learning: We have videos and Power Point presentations that are specifically designed to educate the community. Get out there: One of the best ways to learn is by immersion. Practice tracking actual animals, forestry techniques, analyzing soil and identifying native and invasive plants, and animals in their habitat. If you can make time, come visit the Nature Center for outdoors, hands-on programs.
